text: The Reyrolle 7SR45 Argus is a non-directional overcurrent and earth fault protection relay. It provides reliable protection and advanced functionality for a range of power system configurations.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR45?

text: Protect your power systems from overcurrent and earth faults. The Reyrolle 7SR45 offers definite time and inverse time protection functions for sensitive and timely fault detection with modern hardware technology.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR45?

text: Keep your operations running smoothly with self-powered or dual-powered options. Rely on accurate, quick fault detection for improved system reliability. A compact design, front USB port and Reydisp Evolution PC Software integration streamline setup and maintenance.
heading: Why Reyrolle 7SR45?

text: Protect electrical systems from overcurrent and earth faults with precise, timely detection. Minimize downtime and prevent equipment damage while maintaining a stable, secure power network.
heading: Protect your system

text: Optimize operational efficiency and control with enhanced security and remote capabilities. Flexible power and SCADA connectivity streamline relay monitoring and management. Respond faster to system events for improved control.
heading: Improve efficiency

text: Simplify maintenance and setup with an intuitive user interface. Navigation keys, an LCD and a front USB port support efficient work flows.
heading: Simplify configuration and maintenance

text: Implement definite and inverse time overcurrent and earth fault protection with 0.1 to 0.2 ⋅ I rated sensitivity for phase overcurrent. Expect reliable fault detection and system safety.
heading: Comprehensive overcurrent protection

text: The 7SR45 dual power supply ensures uninterrupted operation by utilizing CT power whenever auxiliary power is not available.
